subject: Request: two-week pilot runway and rate alternatives
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@datapulse.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension request

Hi Vanessa / Laura,

Thanks again for the run so far — the team at DataPulse has been able to validate a couple of important workflows and we want to avoid a gap while we finish the last integration. Can we extend the 30-day pilot by two weeks? Procurement is asking for two possible price structures we can share internally:

  1) Flat credit top-up (e.g., add X tokens / credits to the existing pilot for a one-time fee)
  2) Prorated daily extension at our current trial rate (adjusted for usage)

Couple of constraints: we need clarity on whether the extension preserves the current usage cap / GPU priority (we're running a burst job that needs consistent throughput), and procurement will likely ask for a short invoice or LOI they can attach to the PO.

Can you send options + what you need from our side to keep the pilot running? We ideally need a decision by Friday, Jul 16.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Shah
CTO, DataPulse
samir@datapulse.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@datapulse.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request

Hi Samir — appreciate the note and great to hear the pilot is showing value. Below are two clean options; I’ve attached an updated SOW (DataPulse_POC_SOW_v2.pdf) that notes the extension window for your legal/procurement team.

Option A — Flat credit top-up (recommended for predictable billing):
  • Add a 14-day credit pack priced at $6,000 (covers expected token/compute for current usage profile)
  • Preserves current priority and the same GPU profile for the extension window
  • 10% discount available if you sign an LOI to convert to a paid plan within 30 days after the extension (we can capture that as a non-binding LOI)

Option B — Prorated daily extension (flexible, pay-as-you-go):
  • $450 per day prorated at current trial rate; billed at the end of the extension period
  • Usage caps remain the same but GPU priority is subject to capacity during peaks (we prioritize committed capacity over prorated pilots)

What we need from you to proceed:
  • Confirmation of option (A or B)
  • If Option A and you want the 10% conversion discount, a short LOI or confirmation email from procurement
  • Any billing data for invoicing (billing contact, PO number if already available)

If helpful I can also prepare a one-page invoice draft for procurement. Will follow up with a draft invoice by end of day.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
phone: +1 415-555-0147

Attachment: DataPulse_POC_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

From: Samir Shah <samir@datapulse.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@datapulse.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request

Thanks Vanessa — that’s helpful. A couple of clarifying Qs before I run this through procurement: 

  • For Option A, does the 14-day credit pack guarantee the same GPU nodes so our burst jobs aren’t throttled? We can’t risk variance during heavy inference runs.
  • On the 10% conversion discount — is that applied to the flat credit fee only or to the first month of committed usage after conversion? Need to know for internal TCO modeling.
  • Procurement will ask for a short invoice/LOI. If you can send a draft invoice we can attach that to the PO and expedite approvals.

Also, any chance of a small concession on the flat amount? We have a finance freeze this quarter and a small discount will help accelerate internal approvals.

Appreciate it — Samir

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@datapulse.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request — invoice & concession

Hi Samir — looping in directly from commercial side. Per Vanessa’s note I drafted an invoice and confirmed the GPU priority guarantee for the flat credit option. Points below and attached is an invoice draft (pilot-extension-invoice-draft.pdf) you can attach to the PO.

Summary:
  • Flat credit pack: $6,000 — preserves current GPU nodes and priority for the 14-day window (we reserve the same node class for pilots with flat prepay)
  • Conversion discount: 10% applied to the flat credit fee (so $5,400) if LOI/commitment to convert within 30 days is provided
  • Concession: We can offer an additional one-time operational concession of $500 off the invoice (final invoice $4,900) to help with your quarter-end constraints — requires LOI or a procurement email confirming intent to convert within the 30-day window

Next steps:
  1) If you confirm the flat pack we’ll issue a proper invoice and send a DocuSign envelope for signature.
  2) If procurement prefers the prorated approach we can still do that but we can’t guarantee node-reservation during potential peak bursts.

Karthik — can you confirm legal is OK with LOI wording that our team will send?

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
phone: +1 212-555-0199

Attachment: pilot-extension-invoice-draft.pdf (PDF, 55KB)

From: Samir Shah <samir@datapulse.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@datapulse.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request — invoice & concession

Vanessa / Laura — thanks, that works for us. We’ll take the flat credit pack and the concession you outlined (final invoice $4,900). Procurement will route a short LOI to you this afternoon confirming intent to convert within 30 days; please send the DocuSign link and final invoice once you receive it.

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to the extra runway.

Best,
Samir
CTO, DataPulse
